headline: Fresno Pacific lose at home to Cal State San Marcos
dek: Fresno Pacific opened conference play with a home defeat by Cal State San Marcos, the only visitors to win on the opening day. No side in the conference has outscored them across all matches, yet they have now lost three of their eight.
displaced_by: conference play opened on 2026-09-18: Fresno Pacific, the conference's top scorers, lost at home to Cal State San Marcos, the only away win of the six matches
